name: Daniel Boone National Forest: Forest Service-owned land
about: Forest Service-OWNED land inside Daniel Boone National Forest's outer line, from the Forest Service's own ownership map (EDW Basic Ownership; its content is dated 2015, so land bought since may be missing: not shown here = check the official map). Built by .github/scripts/kpc_owned.py. The outer (proclamation) line ky-dbnf.geojson is drawn only as a faint dashed line: 'Forest boundary line: not all land inside is public' (ruling Oct 27).
